sources.title: Capital One Mobile App — Download Today
sources.date_kind: none visible (copyright 2026; App Store rating dated 12/21/2023)
sources.page_scope: Mobile app feature overview with footnotes (same URL as S11)
sources.claim: App shows balances, transactions, Eno alerts, card lock, CreditWise, rewards redemption, auto loan view/payments, subscription view/block/cancel, iOS widget, biometrics, two-step auth, mobile deposit, Add Cash in store, virtual cards, wallet add, Zelle, card activation; new accounts may take up to 72 hours to appear.
caveats: Not all features available to all customers
Card Lock exempts returns, credits, payments, interest, dispute adjustments, fees, downtime purchases
Email/app alerts unavailable for retail partner cards
Virtual cards not available for debit or some credit cards
sources.local_note: Feature list incl. subscription manager 'view, block or cancel'; Add Cash $999/txn, $1,500/day, $5,000/month, 10x/month; virtual card access within 30 days of account opening, full line after physical card activation; wallets named: PayPal and Google Pay; new accounts up to 72 hours.

sources.title: All-In-One Subscription Management with Capital One
sources.claim: Credit cardholders can view auto-identified subscriptions, block recurring charges from a merchant, or request cancellation at select merchants via Minna Technologies at no cost.
caveats: Credit cards only
Not all recurring charges identified
Block persists until it expires, is removed by Capital One, or customer allows charges (no fixed term stated)
Cancellation usually <5 business days
Merchant may override blocks or charge cancellation fees
sources.local_note: Block declines all recurring charges from the merchant and does not end the merchant relationship; cancellation via Minna Technologies at select merchants usually takes less than five business days.

sources.title: Managing expected transactions
sources.claim: Expected Transactions identifies recurring charges from history; blocked recurring transactions are not approved for 12 months; cancellation typically resolved within 5 calendar days for participating merchants.
caveats: 12-month block term conflicts with CR-CO-02 open-ended wording
'5 calendar days' conflicts with CR-CO-02 'five business days'
May take a few billing cycles to identify recurring charges
Blocking does not affect already-pending transactions
sources.local_note: If a recurring transaction is blocked, Capital One won't approve it moving forward for 12 months; cancellation request typically resolved within 5 calendar days; can unblock anytime.

sources.title: Eno Card Protection & Security
sources.claim: Eno sends real-time suspicious-activity confirmation prompts and duplicate-charge notifications (same amount, same place, same day) via SMS, email or push.
caveats: Not all customers eligible
Eno may not catch everything
Not a dispute channel
sources.local_note: Duplicate: two charges for the same amount from the same place on the same day trigger a notification; suspicious activity can be flagged in real time.

sources.title: Eno, your Capital One assistant
sources.claim: Eno chat available 24/7 via app, text (227-898), website; supports balance checks and account questions; most robust for credit card customers.
caveats: Requires consent for email/text/app notifications
Message and data rates apply
Some or all features may be unavailable depending on account types
sources.local_note: Most customers can chat with Eno via text, app or website; most robust capabilities for credit card customers; Eno is not a channel for disputes or errors.

sources.title: Get Help With Spending Insights From Eno
sources.claim: Eno alerts for free trials, unusually generous tips, higher-than-usual recurring bills or in-app purchases, merchant credits, and card-decline explanations.
caveats: Requires card account managed online and notifications enabled
May not catch all free trials
sources.local_note: Alert types: free trial reminder before it ends, generous tip, recurring charge increase, credit back, card decline explanation; channels email, push, SMS.

sources.title: 10 Things You Can Ask Eno
sources.claim: Via text: balance, recent transactions, available credit, payment date; via app/online: pay bill, activate card, lock/replace card, update info, find account number, add authorized user.
caveats: Published 2021; current availability of each request not confirmed
sources.local_note: Text 227-898 for balance, recent transactions, available credit, payment date; in app/online ask to pay a bill, activate, lock or replace a card, add authorized user.

sources.title: CreditWise from Capital One
sources.claim: Free for anyone 18+ with SSN matchable at TransUnion; FICO Score 8 from TransUnion; TransUnion and Experian report alerts; dark-web SSN/email monitoring; score simulator; no score impact.
caveats: Score may differ from lender's model
Monitoring unavailable if enrollment data doesn't match credit file
Update frequency not stated
sources.local_note: Anybody can get CreditWise, even non-customers; FICO Score 8 based on TransUnion; alerts for new inquiry or delinquent account; simulator; using it won't hurt your score.

sources.title: What is a Mobile Deposit?
sources.claim: Eligible checking/savings/money market accounts; endorse 'for Capital One mobile deposit'; 9:00 p.m. ET cutoff; next-business-day availability generally; extended holds possible; app shows max amount; no charge.
caveats: Limits vary by account and are only visible in-app
Ineligible: third-party, >6 months old, postdated, 'cash', money orders, traveler's, foreign checks
Some savings accounts have 4-business-day hold (search snippet)
sources.local_note: Submitted on or before 9:00 p.m. ET generally available next business day; app shows the maximum you can deposit; Mobile Deposit is a no charge service.

sources.title: Add Cash to your Eligible Accounts in Store
sources.page_scope: Add Cash in Store product page
sources.claim: Generate a single-use barcode valid 30 minutes in the app and pay cash at Walgreens, Duane Reade, CVS, Kroger family or 7-Eleven; limits $999/txn, $1,500/day, $5,000/month, up to 10 times/month; funds usually within minutes.
caveats: Not at CVS inside Target
Excluded at 7-Eleven/Stripes/Speedway in FinCEN Southwest border affected zip codes
Some locations have varied limits; ID may be required
Consumer accounts only
Retailer fees not stated; mobile page says check with provider
sources.local_note: Barcode single-use, expires after 30 minutes, cannot be screenshot; eligible accounts include 360 Checking, MONEY Teen, 360 Savings; limits $999, $1,500/day, $5,000/month, 10x/month.

sources.title: Using virtual credit cards
sources.claim: General-use and merchant-specific virtual card numbers can be created in the app, website or via Google Pay autofill in Chrome/Android; can lock/unlock or delete; persist through physical card replacement.
caveats: Retail partner cards ineligible; some authorized users excluded
New users must activate physical card first (conflicts with CR-CO-01 30-day new-account access)
Locked physical card blocks virtual card purchases
Not usable in Apple Pay/Google Wallet or in-store; US only
sources.local_note: Delete and replace (general) or Delete (merchant-specific); recurring payments on a deleted virtual number will be declined; if physical card is locked, virtual card purchases won't go through.

sources.title: Eno Browser Extension Discontinued: What to Do Next
sources.claim: As of September 30, 2026 the Eno browser extension is unavailable; create virtual cards via Chrome autofill or app/website; previously created virtual cards keep working until expiry.
caveats: Eno assistant itself continues
sources.local_note: As of September 30, 2026, the Eno browser extension is no longer available; virtual cards previously created will continue to work until they expire.

sources.title: Lock debit card
sources.claim: Debit card can be locked/unlocked in app or web; locking prevents debit card transactions; automatic bill payments and scheduled transfers continue.
caveats: ATM/Zelle behavior under lock not stated
sources.local_note: App: select checking account, lock card, confirm; automatic bill payments and scheduled transfers continue while locked; unlock via same steps.

sources.title: Activating your credit card
sources.claim: Activate via app (Profile > Account & Feature Settings > Activate a Credit Card), web, or phone by confirming 3-digit security code; existing online users must link new card to username first.
caveats: Does not address instant/virtual numbers before activation
sources.local_note: Existing online account holders need to link the new card to their username before activating; all methods confirm the 3-digit security code.

sources.title: Send Money to Family & Friends for Free (Zelle)
sources.claim: Send, request and receive with Zelle from Capital One checking accounts including MONEY Teen; no Capital One fee; send limit viewable in app; no request limit; unenrolled recipients' payments expire after 14 days.
caveats: Payments cannot be canceled once sent to enrolled recipients
No purchase protection
Specific dollar send limit not stated on page
sources.local_note: Capital One does not charge fees to use Zelle; send limits may change and are viewable in the app; payment to unenrolled recipient expires and returns within 14 days.

sources.title: 360 Checking Account Disclosures
sources.claim: Transfers (incl. Zelle) subject to confidential risk-based limits; mobile check deposits generally available first business day after deposit; overdraft options Auto-Decline, Free Savings Transfer, No-Fee Overdraft.
caveats: No fixed Zelle dollar limit stated (a search summary claimed $3,000/24h; not confirmed on this page)
sources.local_note: Limits on amount and frequency of transfers based on confidential fraud and risk criteria; overdraft choices Auto-Decline, Free Savings Transfer, No-Fee Overdraft.

sources.title: How To Earn and Redeem Capital One Miles
sources.claim: Miles can book Capital One Travel, cover travel purchases within 90 days, transfer to partners, gift cards, statement credit/check, Amazon/PayPal checkout, Capital One Entertainment; redeem online or in app.
caveats: No per-option redemption values stated
Miles do not expire while account open and in good standing
sources.local_note: Statement credit as little as two to three business days; checks mailed within three business days; cover eligible travel purchase within 90 days.

sources.title: Add your Capital One card to Google Pay
sources.page_scope: Digital wallet page (Google Pay; sibling pages for Apple Pay and Samsung Pay)
sources.claim: Most Capital One credit and debit cards can be added to Google Pay; Apple Pay similar; Samsung Pay for most credit cards; app can link card to a wallet.
caveats: Observed via search result summaries only, page not fully fetched
Mobile page CR-CO-01 names only PayPal and Google Pay
sources.local_note: Google Pay available for most Capital One credit and debit cards; adding a card unlocks virtual card option on Chrome/Android apps.

sources.title: Account balances at a glance (iOS widget)
sources.claim: iOS home-screen widget shows up to 4 credit card, loan, checking, savings or CD balances without signing in; 3 sizes; requires Remember Me.
caveats: iOS only
No masking/privacy option mentioned
Refresh interval unspecified
sources.local_note: Widget displays balances without signing in; up to 4 accounts per widget; requires Remember Me; only available for iOS devices.

sources.title: Passkeys: A more secure way to sign in
sources.claim: Eligible users can create passkeys via sign-in prompt or security settings and sign in with face, fingerprint or device PIN.
caveats: Eligibility criteria unstated
App support not explicit
sources.local_note: Create passkey from a prompt on sign-in page or security settings; removal requires deleting in Capital One settings and in the device/password manager.

sources.title: How to Access your new account
sources.claim: Brand new accounts can take up to 72 hours to appear online; after that, re-run enrollment to link the account to your username or contact support.
sources.local_note: Brand new accounts can take up to 72 hours to appear online; go through enrollment to make sure the new account has been linked to your username.

sources.title: Discover Card FAQs (Capital One updates)
sources.claim: Discover cardholders migrate in phases to manage accounts in the Capital One website and app; existing wallet tokens keep working; authorized users get new numbers.
caveats: Phased; timing per customer notification
sources.local_note: After migration cardholders use the Capital One website and app; primary cardholders keep their 16-digit numbers; authorized users receive new unique numbers.
